propositions: rebar-janitor Discovery phase must consult `rebar metrics --since/--until --output json` to ground temporal decay findings in historical code-health-lens data (module-size distribution, oversized-module count, churn, refactor-to-addition ratio, cap-change events) rather than one-shot snapshots
agents and contributors cannot discover or use the metrics surface without documentation referencing it from project docs and agent skills
metrics with accrued signal must be distinguishable from `unavailable` state (not accrued yet) so the janitor does not treat absence as zero
the four metric lenses (agent_process, code_health, delivery, gate_economics), source/confidence labels, and unavailable state must be documented in user-guide.md as the human-discoverable reference
the reusable rebar.metrics subsystem (MetricSpec registry and is_authoritative helper) must be discoverable by library consumers in reuse-surface.md
AGENTS.md must have a one-line metrics pointer in its 'Where to read' list
